mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear and hot 100 degrees outside the Verona Public Library, and we are currently under a beautiful full moon.

The city is seeking student artists to design new I Voted stickers for the November election with the contest deadline approaching. Additionally, seniors are encouraged to review the updated waiver and release forms for the popular Trishaw bike program offered through the Senior Center.
We have plenty happening locally, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's.
On July 26, an 83-year-old woman was cited for a hit-and-run crash that occurred near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Stop by Culvers today to enjoy their flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl. They remain open until 10 PM tonight, giving you plenty of time to get your fix.
